|lead='''Attack Run''' is a [[Light]] [[Epic Event]] released as a very-rare foil in [[Reflections]] in January 2000.<ref name="checklist">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/swccgcardlist4.0.pdf Complete Card List v4.0], pp. 28–32 (collecting compilation). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref> It is a foil printing of the [[A New Hope]] card.<ref name="foil-face">[[:File:Reflections-Foil-L-Attack-Run-PSA-72605733-original.jpg|Original printed Reflections foil face]], PSA certification 72605733.</ref>
|game_text=Deploy on Death Star: Trench.<br />
During your move phase, you may make an Attack Run as follows:<br />
'''Enter Trench:''' Move up to 3 of your starfighters into trench (for free). Dark Side may immediately follow with up to 3 TIEs (for free).<br />
'''Provide Cover:''' Identify your lead starfighter (Proton Torpedoes* required) and wingmen (if any). Turbolaser Batteries and TIEs with weapons may now target your starfighters (wingmen first, then lead if no wingmen remaining). Hit starfighters are immediately lost.<br />
'''It’s Away!:''' Draw two destiny.<br />
'''Pull Up!:''' All starfighters now move to Death Star system (for free).<br />
If (total destiny + X + Y - Z) &gt; 15, Death Star is “blown away.”<br />
X = ability of lead pilot or 3 if Targeting Computer is present.<br />
Y = total sites at largest Rebel Base (Yavin 4 or Hoth).<br />
Z = highest ability of TIE pilots in trench.<br />
<nowiki>*</nowiki>Your Proton Torpedoes are immune to Overload.<ref name="foil-face" />
